name: craftsman
description: Stack-agnostic doc-first command loop plus a deterministic quality engine — regression-only lint/type gates, acceptance-criteria enforcement, routed review, language-aware planning, and concurrency-safe per-session state — for any language or toolchain. The generalized evolution of craftsman v0.2.

autonomyLevel.title: Autonomy level
autonomyLevel.description: attended, standard or unattended: sets the PR size that needs approval (100, 400 or 1000 lines).

reviewDepth.title: Review depth
reviewDepth.description: light, standard or deep: how often planning re-derives blind (never, auto or always). light matches today's default.

modelTier.title: Model tier
modelTier.description: Reserved for model routing; accepted and currently unused.

budgetsEnforce.title: Enforce doc budgets
budgetsEnforce.description: Whether arch-check lint fails on doc budget overruns.
